notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market SaaS + professional services firm focused on enterprise knowledge search for legal and compliance teams. Heavy latency sensitivity for interactive workflows (median target < 120ms per query for top-k=10 reranked results) but cost-conscious — wants to benchmark cost/query at 100QPS baseline and projected 500QPS burst.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-28: Intro call (AE Marisol) — described Redwood runtime & routing. Customer: strong preference for pinned models + fallbacks.
- 2026-03-02: Technical deep-dive with SE (Vikram) — reviewed current architecture: PostgreSQL + pgvector prototype, document store in S3, preprocessing pipeline. Discussed embedding drift and reranker integration.
- 2026-03-04: Demo (hosted API flow) recorded — linked ff_20260304_iridium_demo. Ran small reranking example (BM25 -> embeddings -> neural reranker).
- 2026-03-06: Security questionnaire sent; they require SSO, audit logging, and KMS-managed keys for L2.
- 2026-03-09: POC kickoff call - agreed on scope and KPIs.

POC scope & success metrics (customer-provided):
- Index scale: ingest 100M vectors (768-d) and validate index build time + incremental updates.
- Query load: sustain 100 QPS stable, validate 500 QPS burst for 10s windows.
- Latency targets: 95th pct <= 200ms end-to-end with neural reranker; median <120ms for rerank top-10.
- Cost: target cost/query (infra + model) <$0.005 at steady-state 100QPS.
- Quality: reranker to improve click-through proxy metric by 7-10% vs embeddings-only baseline.

Vector DB / connector requirements called out by customer:
- Must support approximate NN with configurable recall/ef/candidate size.
- Connector surface must allow hybrid search (BM25 + ANN) and preserve document metadata for reranker stage.
- Need push/pull connector for pgvector (current), Pinecone (preferred by infra team), and an eventual on-prem Weaviate option for regulated clients.
- Liveness: connector must support backpressure and graceful degradation (route to smaller model or cached results) when vector DB latency spikes.
- Bulk ingest with deduplication and schema versioning; incremental upserts with low write amplification.

Architecture preferences / notes from SE convo:
- Prefers routing: embeddings compute in a separate autoscaled pool, nearest-neighbor search in Dedicated node group; reranker as low-latency microservice collocated with search to avoid network hops.
- Concern about KV cache invalidation when documents updated frequently (legal errata).
- Wants standardized observability: per-route latency, per-request token breakdown, and per-vector-db-percentile search time.

Commercial / procurement comments:
- Budget contingent on POC numbers + reference customer (needs one enterprise ref check).
- Prefers annual committed model for Dedicated if performance/cost match POC.

Quotes and chatter (raw):
- "If we can hit sub-150ms for reranker at our 100QPS baseline, we can consolidate three search teams." — Head of Platform (paraphrase).
- "We like pgvector for portability but Pinecone ops look attractive; need to see cost delta." — Infra lead.
